title: From Prejudice to Parity: A New Approach to Debiasing Large Language Model Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Calculated using Mean Average Cosine Similarity (MAC) to measure projection of word embeddings onto gender subspaces, and evaluated using stereotype agreement scores on StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs benchmark datasets.
